profileCms.agent.title: Bring your own agent
profileCms.agent.description: Use your own agent subscription or API account to help with writing and design. Every template also works with the studio’s point-and-click controls.
profileCms.agent.fileHelp: Download your website and its instructions, give the file to your agent, then upload its proposal here. The kit includes every page. You review the result before adding it to your draft.
profileCms.agent.invalidFile: This proposal could not be read. Use the proposal format in the agent kit, keep the website identity and existing artwork unchanged, and keep the file under 1 MB.
profileCms.agent.stale: The proposal or saved draft has changed. Refresh and review the latest version before continuing.
profileCms.agent.legacyHelp: The older patch format edits the first page only. Use the agent kit above for complete websites with several pages.
profileCms.agent.summarySource: This summary was written by the external agent. Check the website and changes below.
profileCms.agent.reviewHelp: Review the writing, artwork, links and each page. Publication still requires your separate approval and wallet signature.
profileCms.agent.connectHelp: Give an agent temporary access to one saved draft. It can read that draft and submit proposals using your existing artwork. You control saving and publication. Add new artwork in the studio before creating access.
profileCms.agent.saveFirst: Sign in as the profile owner and save your current changes as a draft to create access or save a proposal. Existing access can still be revoked below.
profileCms.agent.noProposals: No proposals yet. After your agent submits one, refresh to review it here.
profileCms.agent.saveFailed: The proposed draft could not be confirmed as saved. Check draft history and refresh its status before trying again.
profileCms.agent.requestFailed: Agent access could not be updated. Check that you are signed in as the owner, then refresh and try again.
profileCms.agent.quota: The access limit has been reached. Revoke unused connections or try again after the limit resets.
profileCms.agent.keyHelp: This key is shown once. Put it in your agent client’s environment settings, following the setup guide. Keep it out of chat prompts and website files. It expires automatically and can be revoked here.
profileCms.agent.copyFailed: Copy was unavailable. Show the key and copy it from the field.
profileCms.agent.savedStatusPending: Your proposed draft was saved. The agent’s review status could not be updated yet. Retry the status update without saving another draft.
profileCms.agent.saveConfirmationPending: Your save may have reached 6529. Confirm its result before saving another agent proposal.
profileCms.agent.saveCheckpointUnavailab: Safe save recovery is unavailable in this browser. Enable local storage and use a browser with Web Locks to save connected agent proposals.
